FEAT-3-S75.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Definition
FEAT-3-S75.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, distance, travel duration). Ensure strict validation for tool usage.

FEAT-3-S76.title: Clinical Trials Search Core Logic Orchestration
FEAT-3-S76.description: Implement orchestration logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, extract trial locations, and compute travel distance and duration using Google Routes API.

FEAT-3-S77.title: Clinical Trials End-to-End Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S77.description: Create integration tests validating full flow: validated input → service execution → tool router exposure → response formatting, including recruiting filter enforcement and distance calculation presence.
FEAT-3-S77.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials integration tests found; must be created under backend/tests/
